activation_target: Global-average-pooled last-block units, not individual spatial feature positions
fitting: Float64 unregularized least squares on fit half only; right-Hamilton affine map 4+4, diagonal affine 4+4, unrestricted affine 16+4 coefficients
pair_selection: Greedy lowest fit-half class-centered single-pair logit residual MSE; disjoint keeper/victim endpoints; deterministic index ties; own pairs for each map
gate: If either compression map meets both aggregate held-out logit-MSE ratios in at least 2/3 seeds, physically evaluate both maps and all controls in all seeds. Otherwise preserve diagnostics and skip physical compression.
scope: A bounded activation/merging pilot on three existing CNNs. No new CNN training, algebra search, novel-method claim or blind-test claim. Coefficients fitted to calibration are folded into the existing readout and are not additional inference parameters.
